scenario: Credit-score objection from a customer with an existing home loan. Exercises the two-sided honest answer (helps if paid on time, hurts at 30 days past due) and the soft-vs-hard-enquiry distinction. Also asks a merchant-coverage question that must not be answered from memory.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Good afternoon, this is Anjali from PayFlex. Before we go ahead — this call may be recorded and I'm using an AI assistant to help me quote accurate details. Is that alright?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you. You'd enquired about splitting a purchase into three payments. What can I help with?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: My main worry is my credit score. I've got a home loan application going in next month and I don't want anything messing with my CIBIL right now.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: That's a very sensible thing to check before you commit. Let me give you the accurate picture.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: So does just checking my eligibility put an enquiry on my report? Because I've heard too many enquiries look bad.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, and if I take it and pay everything on time, does that actually help or does it just sit there neutral?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: It does get reported — let me give you both sides of that so there's no surprise later.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Alright, that's fair enough. You're not overselling it, I appreciate that.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: One more thing — can I use this at Croma? That's where I'm buying the washing machine.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Let me check the current partner list rather than guess at it.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay good. And the total is definitely just the price of the machine, nothing added?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Correct — let me confirm the exact split for your cart value.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Right, let's set it up then. I'll do the KYC now.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, mandate is done and it's showing the three dates. All good, thank you.
